tools.name: get_skip_prices
tools.description: Indicative 2026 UK skip hire price ranges (low, median, high in GBP) per skip size for a Rent-a-Skip town or a postcode area. Provide exactly one of town_slug or postcode_area. Prices are confirmed on the booking call with a vetted local operator.

town_slug.description: Rent-a-Skip town slug, for example "westbury" or "milton-keynes". Use check_coverage to find one.

postcode_area.description: UK postcode area letters, for example "BA" or "M". A district or full postcode is reduced to its area.

tools.name: get_permit_info
tools.description: Council skip permit rules for placing a skip on a public road: fee, permit period, notice needed, renewal, application link, last-verified date and data confidence. Provide exactly one of council_name or town_slug. A skip on a private driveway needs no permit.

council_name.description: Highways authority name, case-insensitive, for example "Kent" or "Wiltshire Council".

town_slug.description: Rent-a-Skip town slug, for example "westbury" or "milton-keynes". Use check_coverage to find one.

tools.name: recommend_skip_size
tools.description: Recommends a skip size for a job from its type, waste type and scale, using the same rules as the Rent-a-Skip skip size calculator. Returns capacity, weight guidance, the national indicative price range and the calculator link.

job_type.description: The kind of job. One of: "home-garage-clearance" (Home or garage clearance: Decluttering, furniture, general household waste); "bathroom-refit" (Bathroom refit: Suite, tiles, a little plasterboard); "kitchen-refit" (Kitchen refit: Cabinets, worktops, flooring, appliances); "garden-clearance" (Garden clearance: Greenery, turf, branches, landscaping waste); "general-renovation" (General renovation: Multiple rooms or a whole-house refresh); "construction-trade" (Construction or trade: Building sites, extensions, partition walls).

waste_type.description: The waste type. One of: "general" (General or light: Mixed household, wood, furniture, garden waste); "heavy" (Heavy: Soil, rubble, brick, concrete).

scale.description: Job scale from 1 to 5: 1 = Small, a car boot or two; 2 = Modest, a small van load; 3 = Average, about one full room; 4 = Large, several rooms; 5 = Very large, a whole property.

placement.description: Optional. Where the skip will sit; drives permit guidance, never the size. One of: "driveway" (Driveway or private land: No council permit needed); "road" (Road, pavement or verge: Needs a council permit).

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Checks whether Rent-a-Skip covers a UK town (by name or slug) and returns the town page URL, county and county hub URL. Booking is by phone to a vetted local operator.

query.description: A UK town name or Rent-a-Skip town slug, for example "Westbury" or "leigh-on-sea".
